core.store.note: P6-06 ships InMemoryStore and the 0600 FileStore (the JVM's store, which supports() reports as dependency); P6-12 adds the Android Keystore store over :platform's SecureStore.

config.mirror.note: The Kotlin mirror is rendered by tools/gen-mirrors.ts (--lang kotlin); the :config tests compile the committed sample.

devices.fingerprint.note: P6-06's :core derives fingerprints and device ids from supplied inputs and passes every fingerprint.json section in :conformance; P6-12 adds Android's inputs (the app-scoped id and the Keystore anchor).

devices.facts.note: JvmDeviceFactsSource reads a JVM desktop; Android's inputs (Build, package-manager probes) arrive through the same DeviceFactsSource port from P6-12.

devices.attest.note: P6-09 brings the standard Play Integrity API into :platform for native hosts; as in Swift (App Attest in PolarisKeyPlatform), no work package wires attestation into the Kotlin SDK client.

identity.oidc.note: Only through a host-supplied sign-in closure, as in Swift; no work package gives the Kotlin SDK its own browser sign-in (P6-07).

update.check.note:
:update's UpdateClient.check(): GET /

/update/version with the token when held, a 403's wire code, updateAvailable by Core's Semver (UpdateClientTest).

update.feed.note: :core's verifyFeed, feedClaims, reloadFeeds and commitFeed (every feedCases vector, FeedCasesTest); UpdateClient.channelFeed() and decide() run them through runUpdateCheck, and Core keeps the feeds slice and its seq floors (the update-feed-rollback transcript).

update.decide.note: :core's decideUpdate, bootDecision, resolveUpdateOutlet, rolloutBucket and runUpdateCheck (every update-matrix.json row and case, UpdateMatrixTest); UpdateClient.decide() over discovery's feed and record templates, the record fetched by hash and verified against pinnedReleaseKeys only (both update transcripts).

update.content.note: :core's feedContent, holdsOf (stampHolds), selectPackRows and decideUpdate with UpdateContentInput; runUpdateCheck runs P4-13 §2.5 steps 10–14 with the packs facet as the UpdateContentHost (every feedContentCases vector and contentRows row, ContentDecisionTest).

update.driver.note: The InstallDriver port is :update's (UpdateClient.install); Play In-App Updates and PackageInstaller are P6-12's. A JVM desktop build has none: JvmInstallDriver throws the typed runtime N/A.

update.bootguard.note: :update's BootGuard over the host's UpdateSlots port (Godot P3-10's semantics: apply-staged and roll-back with skipVersion, failedBoots counted while an applied update is active, the stage-matrix v2 confirmation rows; BootGuardTest); the launch decision is stage-matrix.json's guard and confirm rows (StageMatrixTest). With no slots (a platform-installed Android app, a JVM desktop build) nothing is counted.

outlet.detect.note: P6-06's :core holds detectOutlet and passes every outlet-matrix.json row in :conformance; P6-12 adds the readers over :platform's install source.

packs.record.note: :core's verifyReleaseRecord with pin.kind and :packs' verifyMarker and matchEmbedded (every packRecordCases and markerCases vector, PackRecordTest).

packs.revoke.note: :core's revocationOf, verifyRevocation and newerRevocation (every revocationCases vector); PackEngine keeps the sibling revocations.json (revocationsStored first, never created empty, re-verified per entry on load, relearn, the 256-target cap, torn and unreadable rules) and refuses and unmounts revoked releases (PackEngineTest).

packs.delegation.note: :core's delegated verifyReleaseRecord path (steps 13 and 16), verifyDelegation and recordRevoked; :packs' dataOnlyRefusal (every delegationCases and dataOnlyCases vector, DelegationTest); the engine fetches delegations within MAX_DELEGATIONS_PER_CHECK, refuses non-data-only delegated installs and keeps PackInstall.delegation (PackEngineTest).

packs.delta.feed.note: :core's feedContent reads the feed's deltas menu; :packs' withFeedDeltas merges it before planTarget, and PackEngine tries at most one feed-offered delta per install, falling back on a failed fetch or any delta verdict and journalling it as feedDelta; the update client hands each committed feed's menu to the packs facet (feedContentCases, feedDeltaCases, feedDeltaApplyCases, PackEngineTest).

packs.plan.note: :packs' plan, selectVariant and planTarget (every plan-matrix.json row, variant case and target case, PlanMatrixTest).

packs.index.files.note: :packs' parseFilesIndex, checkPaths and treeDigest (filesIndexCases and pathCases, ContentCorpusTest).

packs.index.chunks.note: :packs' parseChunkIndex and parseChunkIndexBytes (u64 from two little-endian u32 reads composed byte by byte, saturated at 2^53; chunkIndexCases under both zstd paths, ContentCorpusTest).

packs.apply.full.note: applyFull, streamed through zstd-jni's ZstdInputStream (and one-shot without it); applyCases under both paths.

packs.apply.file.note: applyFile with the type-neutral container rebuild; applyCases under both paths.

packs.apply.chunk.note: applyChunk (seed map, chunkRuns, repair pass, run journal resume) over chunkRangeFetch: one bounded Range per run with If-Range and Accept-Encoding identity, an exact Content-Range and ETag, never multi-range; seed indexes under <packs root>/index/ (applyCases, ContentCorpusTest).

except.note: Where zstd-jni's native libzstd cannot load (an Android build without the AAR's natives, P6-12 links the AAR); supports() reports dependency.
Where zstd-jni ships no native binary for the OS or arch; supports() reports dependency.

packs.apply.delta.note: zstd-jni (libzstd 1.5.7): the base as a raw-content dictionary (ZSTD_DCtx_loadDictionary; §2.7 rule 5's magic refusal runs first) with ZSTD_d_windowLogMax, the window check in the applier before every prefix decode; a start-up probe gates zstd-patch-from (applyCases, feedDeltaApplyCases, PackZstdTest).

packs.state.note: PackEngine over DirPackStorage in the store's data directory (never a cache directory): journal, resume with Range/If-Range, atomic pointer swap (fsync before rename), confirm, rollback, GC roots, embedded baselines, a torn state.json held aside, an unreadable one refusing every write; packSetId on devices/report (packSetIdCases, PackEngineTest).

packs.handlers.note: PackHandler (supports, check over a newly staged payload before the state commit -> pack-type-check-failed, activate with the installed payload, deactivate); files.tree, data.json and l10n.table built in; registerHandler for custom types (PackEngineTest, PackTypeHandlersTest).

packs.type.l10n.table.note: L10nTableHandler (built in): PO, CSV and JSON tables by plain parsers scanned as code points, the BCP-47 locale matched to the variant; tables(packId), onActivate/onDeactivate (pack-type-cases.json, PackTypeHandlersTest).

packs.type.data.json.note: DataJsonHandler (built in): every file strict JSON, formatVersions listed by the host; documents(packId) (pack-type-cases.json, PackTypeHandlersTest).

packs.type.ml.model.note: MlModelHandler (host-registered, as in Swift): model.json runtime, quantisation and RAM/VRAM needs against the host budget, then the host load test (TensorFlow Lite, ONNX Runtime) before model(packId) swaps (pack-type-cases.json, PackTypeHandlersTest).

packs.provides.note: PackEngine.isAvailable over the running set and packFor over the targets, from each verified record's provides (unentitled packs never answer; PackEngineTest).

packs.transport.steam.note: As in Swift, no work package builds a Steam-depot transport for a JVM desktop app (P5-08 covers Godot only).

ui.stages.note: :core's bootTransition; every stage-matrix.json row, probe, guard and confirm case in :conformance.

ui.kit.note: P6-11's :ui (polaris-key-ui, Jetpack Compose + Material 3, Android): PolarisBoot over :core's stage machine, the gate (every terminal state and the grace banner), activation, sign-in with QR, settings, devices, the update banner and prompt and pack progress, each with a StateFlow state holder; neutral over the host's MaterialTheme by default, Polaris Key branding behind PolarisBranding.PolarisKey and the Powered-by badge behind showPoweredBy. Proof: every screen's Roborazzi snapshots (light, dark, 200 % font, phone, tablet; neutral and branded) plus the branding, contrast and TalkBack suites.

commerce.receipt.note: Play Billing is a store edge, not an SDK service; P6-01 is the server side. As in Swift, no work package wires receipts into the Kotlin SDK client.
